R3.reason: Flagged "Top inset pieces" are the boards glued to the plywood in step 7 ("top insert piece", viewed image: 4 boards + 2 rips on 14 1/2" x 26" plywood).

R4.reason: Corrected rows fit listed stock: 1.5 x 2.5 from 2x3, 1.5 x 1.5 from 2x2, 1.5 x 5.5 from 2x6, 1.5 x 2 ripped from 2x3, 3/4 x 2.5 from 1x3, plywood 14.5 x 26 from the quarter sheet (24 x 48).

R5.reason: Cut list and image disagree on the inset boards. As written, 1.5"-thick 2x6 parts total cutList[3] 2x30 + cutList[6] 4x14.5 = 118 > 1 x 72 bought (materials[3] "Board, 2x6 72""). The viewed step-7 image says "Use 4- 1x6 boards and rip down 2- 2" boards" (3/4" thick, 1 1/2" with the plywood), which would be 4x14.5 + 2x14.5 = 87 <= 96 from materials[4] 1x6; then 2x6 need is only 60 <= 72. Cannot tell which is right.
